svg.title: Pi 5: frame jitter, normal vs real-time priority
svg.desc: Realistic mixed load. The same runs, with the timer thread granted SCHED_FIFO or not.
svg.text: Pi 5: frame jitter, normal vs real-time priority
Realistic mixed load. The same runs, with the timer thread granted SCHED_FIFO or not.
Hollow marker: jitter or broken. Frames are due every 20 ms; median of the runs at each count.
